## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 grid is built on branch tom/dashboard-grid-v2: react-grid-layout with drag/resize, layout persisted server-side via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout with a localStorage fallback, widget sizing via ResizeObserver (replacing container queries for iOS 15 support), DashboardTile renamed to WidgetCard, and a storybook CSS resolution fix. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 is open; the Zest demo is Tuesday the 24th and Priya's UX review is still pending.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 awaits Priya's UX review (iPad/iOS 15 check)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 flag for the Zest workspace only (flags admin, no code change)
- [prochaine-étape] Keep v1 dashboards and the DashboardTile re-export until January, per the demo plan
- [essai-raté] Container queries in WidgetCard: ignored by iOS 15 Safari, so replaced entirely by a ResizeObserver-based useWidgetSize hook
- [essai-raté] First storybook build failed on react-grid-layout CSS subpath import; fixed via .storybook/preview.ts and optimizeDeps
- [décision] Drop container queries completely, single sizing system (source: t09)
- [décision] Server-side layout persistence, nothing removed, flag on only for Zest, old dashboards stay until January (source: t15)
